## Checklist

- [ ] File is inside a company subfolder: `interview-experiences/{company-slug}/{role-slug}-{yyyy}-{mm}.md`
- [ ] Company folder name is all lowercase with hyphens (e.g. `squarepoint-capital`)
- [ ] Filename follows the convention — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) if unsure
- [ ] All required sections are present: Overview, Interview Process, Key Topics Covered, Outcome, Tips for Future Candidates
- [ ] All Overview fields filled in: Company, Role, Location, Interview Date, Experience Level, Application Source
- [ ] `**Result**` uses one of the accepted values: `Selected` / `Offer Extended` / `Rejected` / `Ghosted` / `Neutral` / `Not Communicated`
- [ ] Bullets use `*` (not `-`)
- [ ] Round headings use `### Round N – {Type}` format
- [ ] No personal information about interviewers included
- [ ] Coding problem links are working (LeetCode, HackerRank, etc.)
- [ ] Added a row to the table in `README.md`
